div.head: I Cn 3
div.ab: And gyf elles be cwicum mannum ciricgrið abrocen sy, bete man georne be þam þe seo dæd sy, sy hit þurh feohtlac, si hit þurh reaflac, sig þurh þæt þe hi[t] sy.
And gif elles be cwycum mannum cyricgryð abrocen sy, bete man georne beo þam þe seo dæde sie, sy hyt þurh feohtlac, sy hit þurh reaflac, sy þurh þæt þe hit sy.
Si uero aliter sine interfectione pax ęcclesię fracta sit, emendetur secundum quod acciderit, sit per pugnam sit per robariam, sit per id quod sit.
And gyf elles be cwicum mannum ciricgrið abrocen sy, bete man georne be þam þe seo dæd sy, sy hit þurh feohtlac, si hit þurh reaflac, sig þurh þæt he hi[t] sy.
And gyf elles be cwicum mannum ciricgrið abrocen sy, bete man georne be þam þe seo dæd sy, sy hit þurh feohtlac, si hit þurh reaflac, sig þurh þæt þe hit sy.

Und wenn sonst, [nämlich] im Falle der [angegriffene] Mensch leben bleibt, der Kirche Sonderfrieden gebrochen wird, büsse jener willig, je nachdem die Missethat ist, sei es durch Fechten, sei es durch Raub, sei es durch was es auch sei:

And if otherwise, [namely] where the [attacked] people stay alive, a church's protection is broken, let it be eagerly compensated according to what the deed is, whether by fighting or by robbery or by whatever it may be:

And if the protection of the church is broken in some other respect, without the taking of life, amends shall diligently be made in accordance with the nature of the offence, whether it be fighting or robbery or whatever it may be.

And if the sanctuary of the church is violated in some other way without the loss of life, penance shall be readily carried out according to the nature of the deed, whether it is violence or robbery or whatever it may be.
div.note: G reads ‘hi’ for ‘hit’. Liebermann compares VIII Atr 4.
